title: Strength Definition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately define 'strength' in terms of coupling constants and interaction cross sections.

title: Strength Comparison
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide a quantitative comparison of the strengths of the four interactions using dimensionless constants.

title: Conservation Laws
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and state the conservation laws applicable to strong, electromagnetic, and weak interactions.

title: Experimental Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student must justify the conservation laws with relevant experimental evidence.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as misidentifying conservation laws or failing to mention key interactions.
